name: redteam_4_1
comment: Red team 4_1 (hug_then_leave, aimed at #7,#5,#1): The route hugs a long free wall 1.3 m to its left, then veers 33 deg right while the wall still runs on behind. The left-back diamond/wedge slot swings behind the wall before the fold or mirror logic reacts, so a wall ends up between the leader and L, or L's slot lands in the wall. Broke 2 (check, choice, members): #1 wall stare. First: #1 blizzard n3 R1 s1 t=6.6s - L at W1.
